title: bug: resumed worktree-mode task runs shared when the pre-flight get_context read fails
description: claim_next_task's alreadyAssigned reply carries no workspace, so on a resume WT-04's provision_worktree / Initialize-MoeWorktree take the mode only from the pre-flight get_context (WT-02). When that one read fails (empty PREFLIGHT_CONTEXT / $null $preflightContext, e.g. a daemon restart), the mode reads as shared. If moe/task/<id> does not exist yet (the first session refused before the add), the CLI then launches in the control checkout with no refusal. Needs a contract decision: an unknown mode should fail closed without changing true shared-mode resumes (epic rail 4). Options: put workspace on alreadyAssigned, or refuse a resume whose context read failed while the control is on moe/control.
reopenReason: Governor promotion from BACKLOG under the human's 2026-10-30 13:00Z delegation of pending decisions. This is a worktree-mode resume bug filed by WT-04's worker. It must be planned before WT-19 flips worktreeMode on. Once the plan names its files, the governor assigns its wrapper-lane slot.

comments.content:
@architect-bd1eb82d Planner input from this row's filer (worker-0062feec). It covers a gap in my own description. I read it from the code at 5657d186 and measured nothing new.

The description names one shape: moe/task/<id> is missing because session 1 refused before the add. There is a second shape. Both shared-mode refusals fire only when the branch exists AND `task_branch_landed HEAD` fails:
- scripts/moe-agent.sh:2886, provision_worktree
- scripts/moe-agent.ps1:2671, Initialize-MoeWorktree
That check is merge-tree, so a branch that holds nothing HEAD lacks counts as landed.

Example: session 1 adds W from a target that moe/control already contains, then dies before any checkpoint reaches moe/task/<id>. Its work exists only as uncommitted dirt in W. If the resume's get_context read then fails, the seat runs shared in the control checkout with no refusal and never sees W.

Both candidate fixes cover this shape, because neither keys on the branch:
- workspace on alreadyAssigned (HeldTaskRefusal in packages/moe-daemon/src/util/claimEligibility.ts)
- refuse a failed context read while control is on moe/control
A fix keyed on a missing branch would miss this shape.

Suggested regression, both twins: the branch is present with zero commits beyond a base that HEAD contains, W is dirty, and the get_context read fails. Expect a refusal with one report_blocked, no CLI launch, and W plus its dirt intact. The fake proxy already has FAKE_CLAIM_MODE=resume (alreadyAssigned) and FAKE_GET_CONTEXT_FAIL=empty, which answers {}. Check whether 'empty' takes the same wrapper path as a transport failure. If it doesn't, the missing piece is a knob that fails the call.

Status: QA accepted in chat (msg-daa7d2c7) that this gap stays with this row and does not block WT-04.
